 Preview UToledo Invites Prospective Students, Families to Experience Rocket Life on Oct. 23
 October 21, 2026 | News , 
 UToday , 
 Alumni By Staff 
 The University of Toledo welcomes prospective students and their families to Main Campus on Friday, Oct. 23, for Preview UToledo, a fall open house designed to help students explore academic opportunities, experience campus life and learn more about the college admission process.
 The free, public event begins at 9:30 a.m. in Thompson Student Union and features opportunities to connect with current students, faculty, admission counselors and representatives from across the University.
 UToledo welcomes prospective students and their families to Main Campus on Friday for Preview UToledo, a fall open house designed to help high school and transfer students explore, experience and learn more about the University and being a Rocket.
 Preview UToledo is open to high school students, particularly juniors and seniors, as well as transfer students and others considering UToledo. Prospective students and families are encouraged to register in advance at the Preview UToledo website .
 “Preview UToledo is an opportunity for prospective students and their families to experience firsthand what makes UToledo special,” said Heather Lutz, director of enrollment events and visits. “From exploring academic programs and touring campus to connecting with current students and learning about financial aid, we want every guest to leave with a better understanding of the opportunities available here and what it means to be a Rocket.”
 Throughout the day, attendees can participate in a variety of activities, including:
 College Academic and Resource Fairs: Meet representatives from UToledo’s academic colleges and learn about student organizations, campus resources and support services.
 Campus and Residence Hall Tours: Explore campus and visit Parks Tower or Honors Academic Village to experience residential life.
 Admission and Financial Aid Sessions: Learn about the application process, scholarships, financial aid and FAFSA.
 Student Panel: Hear directly from current Rockets about their experiences, campus involvement and opportunities at UToledo.
 Application Submission Station: Receive assistance and submit an application for admission.
 College Facility Tours: Explore academic facilities and learn more about specific programs and hands-on learning opportunities.
 Guests also can enjoy a fall-themed lunch, hot cider and seasonal treats throughout the day.
 Campus Community Encouraged to Welcome Future Rockets 
 With prospective students and families exploring campus throughout the day, UToledo faculty, staff and students are encouraged to help create a welcoming experience.
 Members of the campus community are invited to wear their Rocket gear on Friday, Oct. 23, show their UToledo pride and extend a friendly welcome to visiting students and families.
 “Every interaction a prospective student has on our campus helps shape their impression of UToledo,” Lutz said. “Whether it’s a conversation with a faculty member, a friendly greeting from a staff member or a current student sharing their experience, those moments can make a lasting difference. We want our future Rockets to see and feel the pride we have in our University.”
 Faculty, staff, students and alumni also are encouraged to share information about Preview UToledo with high school students and families who may be interested in attending.
 For additional information and to register, visit utoledo.edu/admission/preview .
